title: Winspace T1600 bike test: gallery + series intro: 'Try Before You Buy' –  a review you can do too

takeaways.text: Introductory gallery of an Ultegra Di2 T1600 lent for a month by Winspace's Australian agent; the presenter scuffed a dropout on sandstone during the first photo shoot, a casual test of the paint's resilience.

disclosure: The presenter says Winspace's Australian agent loaned the bike for a month.
summary: Gallery and series introduction for an Australian month-long loan of an Ultegra Di2 T1600; first impressions of finish and weight, with the ride review to follow.
